title: Lumière Oval Solitaire Ring
descriptionHtml:
One oval, held in four claws. A single oval cut clear cubic zirconia, about 8mm by 6mm, held in four slim gold claws on a plain polished band. Small enough for every day, and part of the Lumière line of oval cut pieces. It adjusts to fit US 5 to 8.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Lumière Oval Necklace.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 8
  • Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8mm by 6mm
  • Setting: Four slim gold claws
  • Band: Plain polished, approximately 2mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
